changeSet.author: dcre
changeSet.createView: SELECT client, process_date, 'SUBMITTED' AS stage, 1 AS stage_order, count(*) AS tx_count, sum(amount) AS total_amount FROM rpt.v_tx WHERE client = upper(current_user::STRING) OR current_user = 'rpt_internal' GROUP BY client, process_date UNION ALL SELECT client, process_date, 'CTV_PASS', 2, count(*), sum(amount) FROM rpt.v_tx WHERE ctv_outcome = 'PASS' AND (client = upper(current_user::STRING) OR current_user = 'rpt_internal') GROUP BY client, process_date UNION ALL SELECT client, process_date, 'EMITTED', 3, count(*), sum(amount) FROM rpt.v_tx WHERE emitted AND (client = upper(current_user::STRING) OR current_user = 'rpt_internal') GROUP BY client, process_date UNION ALL SELECT client, process_date, 'SETTLED', 4, count(*), sum(amount) FROM rpt.v_tx WHERE status = 'ACSC' AND (client = upper(current_user::STRING) OR current_user = 'rpt_internal') GROUP BY client, process_date

changeSet.author: dcre
changeSet.createView: SELECT h.client_token AS client, (substr(h.business_date,1,4)||'-'||substr(h.business_date,5,2)||'-'||substr(h.business_date,7,2))::DATE AS process_date, t.e2e, h.created_at AS ingested_at, ce.created_at AS emitted_at, p.created_at AS settled_at, ce.created_at - h.created_at AS ingest_to_emit, p.created_at - ce.created_at AS emit_to_settle, p.created_at - h.created_at AS end_to_end, (p.created_at::DATE - (substr(h.business_date,1,4)||'-'||substr(h.business_date,5,2)||'-'||substr(h.business_date,7,2))::DATE)::INT AS settlement_day_offset FROM public.tx_entry t JOIN public.tx_header h ON h.arrival_id = t.arrival_id JOIN public.crw_emission_member cm ON cm.e2e = t.e2e JOIN public.crw_emission ce ON ce.id = cm.emission_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (e2e) e2e, created_at FROM public.pbsr_resp ORDER BY e2e, created_at DESC) p ON p.e2e = t.e2e WHERE h.client_token = upper(current_user::STRING) OR current_user = 'rpt_internal'

changeSet.author: dcre
changeSet.createView: SELECT h.client_token AS client, ce.run_date AS process_date, ce.file_name, count(cm.e2e) AS emitted_count, sum(cm.amount) AS control_sum, count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.status = 'ACSC') AS settled_count, COALESCE(sum(cm.amount) FILTER (WHERE p.status = 'ACSC'), 0) AS settled_sum, sum(cm.amount) - COALESCE(sum(cm.amount) FILTER (WHERE p.status = 'ACSC'), 0) AS variance FROM public.crw_emission ce JOIN public.crw_emission_member cm ON cm.emission_id = ce.id JOIN public.tx_header h ON h.arrival_id = ce.arrival_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (e2e) e2e, status FROM public.pbsr_resp ORDER BY e2e, created_at DESC) p ON p.e2e = cm.e2e WHERE h.client_token = upper(current_user::STRING) OR current_user = 'rpt_internal' GROUP BY h.client_token, ce.run_date, ce.file_name

changeSet.author: dcre
changeSet.createView: SELECT f.client, f.debtor_account, f.process_date AS fail_date, f.reason, f.amount, min(s.process_date) AS cured_date, (min(s.process_date) - f.process_date)::INT AS days_to_cure FROM rpt.v_fails f LEFT JOIN rpt.v_tx s ON s.client = f.client AND s.debtor_account = f.debtor_account AND s.status = 'ACSC' AND s.process_date > f.process_date WHERE f.client = upper(current_user::STRING) OR current_user = 'rpt_internal' GROUP BY f.client, f.debtor_account, f.process_date, f.reason, f.amount

changeSet.author: dcre
changeSet.createView: SELECT client, process_date, CASE WHEN amount < 100 THEN 'A_0_100' WHEN amount < 500 THEN 'B_100_500' WHEN amount < 1000 THEN 'C_500_1K' WHEN amount < 5000 THEN 'D_1K_5K' ELSE 'E_5K_PLUS' END AS bucket, count(*) AS tx_count, sum(amount) AS total_amount, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'RJCT' OR status LIKE 'FAIL%') AS failed_count FROM rpt.v_tx WHERE client = upper(current_user::STRING) OR current_user = 'rpt_internal' GROUP BY client, process_date, bucket
